name: Website Review & Improvements
detail: Review of up to five existing pages, focused on messaging, navigation, and customer next steps. Up to ten prioritized recommendations, one agreed batch of small improvements with up to two hours for implementation and checking, and a 45-minute walkthrough. Platform suitability and access confirmed before booking. New pages, substantial copywriting, redesigns, technical troubleshooting, and comprehensive technical, SEO, or accessibility audits are separate.

name: Social Media Support
detail: Monthly content calendar, six posts with captions and simple graphics using supplied assets, including up to two three-slide carousels. One platform or coordinated Instagram and Facebook using the same six core posts. Scheduling after approval, a brief results summary, a 30-minute monthly call, and one consolidated revision round. Kickoff and initial direction included; first-month timing agreed upfront. Photography, video, ads, and daily inbox or comment management are separate.

name: Multi-Channel Marketing Support
detail: Monthly planning and hands-on work across two selected channels. Social + email: four social posts and two emails. Social + website: four social posts and one website update batch capped at 90 minutes. Email + website: two emails and that website update batch. Each email includes up to 400 words drafted from supplied information, an existing template, one audience per send, checks, and scheduling after approval. Includes a 45-minute monthly call, available-results review, one consolidated revision round, kickoff, and initial direction. Additional work, new templates, automations, and technical work are scoped separately.

name: Marketing Working Session
detail: A focused 45-minute session about one marketing question, with light preparation and a concise follow-up of recommended next steps. A standalone paid service, not required before monthly support. The initial 20-minute call to discuss fit and services is free.

name: Larger website project or additional support
detail: Website refreshes, additional social content, email production, Google Business Profile work, and other website updates are scoped and quoted case by case. Describe the work in your project details. No price is included in the estimate for this selection.
